finding: No Michelin Guide selection (stars, Bib Gourmand, Green Star, or Recommended) covers any Wisconsin restaurant as of September 2026.
detail: On April 7-8, 2026 Michelin announced a new 'American Great Lakes' guide covering Cleveland, Detroit, Indianapolis, Milwaukee, Minneapolis and Pittsburgh. Inspectors are already dining in Milwaukee, but the inaugural restaurant selection will only be revealed at a ceremony in 2027. Until then every Wisconsin restaurant has michelin_stars=0, bib_gourmand=false, green_star=false.
action_for_2027: Re-check guide.michelin.com after the 2027 American Great Lakes ceremony and update Milwaukee entries.
